methods.validation: frozen policies, held-out seeds; no final-test use
methods.budget: same generation ceiling and configured worst-case physics-step ceiling; actual steps recorded and may differ

definitions.trainingScore: mean legacy task fitness over training courses
definitions.uncertainty: 95% Student t interval across courses, not independent evolutionary runs
definitions.topology: bounded optional body graph; NEAT evolves acyclic neural topology; other controllers use fixed MLPs
definitions.learning: none: fixed lifetime weights; plastic: local reward-modulated Hebbian changes; ppo: on-policy actor-critic updates before deterministic scoring; inheritance explicitly recorded
definitions.geneticDiversity: mean normalised base-body gene standard deviation; evolving neural size shown separately
definitions.behaviouralDiversity: mean pairwise distance over measured behaviour descriptors
definitions.seedPolicy: disjoint train, validation and final test sets; final test never enters selection
definitions.determinism: repeatability within the same runtime; cross-browser bit-identical floating point is not guaranteed
